answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs to a staking vault, where registration fees scale superlinearly (O(N²)) per additional entity, creating exponential capital exhaustion for any coordinating swarm. Even if an attacker drafts a convincing sonnet or creates a canyon of fake identities, sustaining unverified clones becomes economically impossible under quadratic staking costs.
